# vercel_environment (Data Source)

Provides information about a Vercel environment.

This data source reads both built-in environments (`production`, `preview`, `development`) and user-managed Custom Environments (`env_*`) through one schema. Resolve an environment by project plus ID or slug.

Built-in environments are managed by Vercel and cannot be imported into or managed by `vercel_custom_environment`. Use `vercel_custom_environment` only for user-managed `env_*` environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vercel_project" "example" {
  name = "example-project"
}

data "vercel_environment" "preview" {
  project_id = data.vercel_project.example.id
  slug       = "preview"
}

data "vercel_environment" "staging" {
  project_id = data.vercel_project.example.id
  id         = "env_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the existing Vercel Project.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The canonical environment ID. Built-in environments use `production`, `preview`, or `development`. Custom Environments use an `env_*` ID. Exactly one of `id` or `slug` must be set.
- `slug` (String) The environment slug. Built-in environments use `production`, `preview`, or `development`. Custom Environments use their configured name. Exactly one of `id` or `slug` must be set.
- `team_id` (String) The team ID to use when reading the environment. Required when configuring a team resource if a default team has not been set in the provider.

### Read-Only

- `branch_tracking` (Attributes) The branch routing configuration for the environment. When set, qualifying git branches deploy into this environment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branch_tracking))
- `capabilities` (Attributes) What this environment can do. Built-in Preview and Production support domains and deployments but cannot be managed as Custom Environments. Development does not support domains or deployments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `created_at` (Number) The timestamp the environment was created, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Null for built-in environments.
- `description` (String) A description of the environment.
- `kind` (String) Whether the environment is a built-in `system` environment or a user-managed `custom` environment.
- `managed_by` (String) Who manages the environment. `vercel` for built-in environments and `user` for Custom Environments.
- `name` (String) The display name of the environment.
- `type` (String) The environment type. One of `production`, `preview`, or `development`. Custom Environments are `preview`.
- `updated_at` (Number) The timestamp the environment was last updated, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Null for built-in environments.

<a id="nestedatt--branch_tracking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `branch_tracking`

Read-Only:

- `pattern` (String) The pattern of the branch name to track.
- `type` (String) How a branch name should be matched against the pattern. One of `startsWith`, `endsWith`, or `equals`.


<a id="nestedatt--capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `capabilities`

Read-Only:

- `deployments` (Boolean) Whether deployments can target this environment.
- `domains` (Boolean) Whether domains can be assigned to this environment.
- `manage` (Boolean) Whether the environment can be created, updated, or deleted through `vercel_custom_environment`. Always false for built-in environments.
